item.name: SHEGLAM Snatch 'n' Define Cream Contour Stick Long-Lasting Sweat-Proof Highly Pigmented Sculpting Face Makeup
item.title: SHEGLAM Snatch 'n' Define Cream Contour Stick Long-Lasting Sweat-Proof Highly Pigmented Sculpting Face Makeup
item.description:
Product Highlights
● Built-In Precision Brush
Features a retractable brush tip for on-the-go blending, ensuring seamless, natural contouring without additional tools.
● Ultra-Smooth Creamy Texture
Lightweight, buttery formula glides on effortlessly without streaking, settling into fine lines, or feeling heavy on skin.
● Highly Pigmented & Long-Lasting
Delivers intense, buildable color that stays put all day, resisting sweat, humidity, and fading for a flawless sculpted look.
● 7 Versatile Shades
Curated by skin tone (Light/Medium/Deep) and undertone (Cool/Neutral/Warm), including Soft Tan (cool light) and Camel Suede (warm deep), to match every complexion.
● Multi-Use Sculpting
Can be used to contour cheekbones, define jawlines, slim noses, or even as an eyeshadow base for a cohesive makeup look.

How to Use
● Step 1: Twist Up the Stick
Rotate the base to push up the product to your desired length.
● Step 2: Apply Directly
Swipe the stick onto areas you want to sculpt, such as your cheekbones, jawline, nose bridge, or forehead.
● Step 3: Blend Immediately
Use the built-in brush or a damp sponge to blend outward for a seamless, gradient finish.
● Step 4: Layer for Intensity
For a more dramatic sculpt, apply a second thin coat and blend again.
● Step 5: Set & Finish
Allow the contour to set for 1-2 minutes, then follow with powder or setting spray for extra longevity.





ATTENTION
Avoid contact with eyes. Do not eat. Keep our of reach of children. Store in a dark, dry place not higher than 25 ℃ or 77 F. In case of redness or allergic reaction, please stop using immediately.

Color:	Warm Honey，Soft Tan，Golden Sun，Tawny Amber， Terracotta，Earthy Sepia，Camel Suede
Type:	Contour Stick
Texture:	Stick
Finish:	Natural

Net Weight: 7.5 g	
Size/CM:  3*3*9.2

INGREDIENTS:POLYETHYLENE,PHENYL TRIMETHICONE,ISOAMYL LAURATE,CETYL ETHYLHEXANOATE,C12-15 ALKYL BENZOATE,ISONONYL ISONONANOATE,DIPENTAERYTHRITYL PENTAISOSTEARATE,POLYMETHYL METHACRYLATE
SILICA,MICA,DIMETHICONE,OCTYLDODECANOL,MICROCRYSTALLINE WAX,SUCROSE ACETATE ISOBUTYRATE,KAOLIN,SILICA DIMETHYL SILYLATE,POLYMETHYLSILSESQUIOXANE,TOCOPHERYL ACETATE,PHYTOSTERYL/OCTYLDODECYL LAUROYL GLUTAMATE,PHENOXYETHANOL,TRIETHOXYCAPRYLYLSILANE,ETHYLHEXYLGLYCERIN,TIN OXIDE,TITANIUM DIOXIDE,IRON OXIDES
